extension.summary: Runtime v3 polished Cobra navigation, guide and player presentation contract.
extension.description: Adds a push-content drawer with View Mode and Power controls, four visually distinct guide modes, internal Back navigation, high-contrast player surfaces, video-only PiP chrome, expanded aspect modes and provider subscription-expiry status while preserving native playback, renderer, rotation, Fold, background/resume and Infinity handoff ownership.
